## Survey open-0: LIN-4466 @ e666c4b60

**The deeper thing: this piece may raise the count its parent is meant to lower.** `lib/prompts/blind-read-words.js` sits in LLM & prompts by its path, but Runs uses it as vocabulary. Seams run 12 says so (§143), and five of the six Runs → LLM edges behind F1's 50 → 55 were imports of `prompts/*-words.js`. At BASE, `run-view.js`, `run-closeout-state.js`, `pipeline-churn.js`, `completion-signals.js` and `wall-clock-summary.js` are all Runs files (`areas.json`), and none of them imports anything from LLM & prompts. Done as written, the piece adds up to five new Runs → LLM edges. **First:** settle where the leaf lives (its path, or how the registry files it) on LIN-4448, before touching any caller. If the answer is "accept the edges", the PR should say so.

**The ground moved.**
- Piece 1 (#2433) is BASE. It added `lib/code-routes.js` with `name: 'blind-read'` and `emits: ['blind-read', 'blocked']`. That site is on no list.
- LIN-4460 and #2427 have merged, so those collisions are gone.
- `run-closeout-state.js` now returns `'blind-read'` (:166) and has the code `'blind-read-missing'`. A substring scan would flag that code wrongly.
- The review's site list is partly stale. `prompt-trace-store.js` has no occurrence. `run-ledger.js` already imports the leaf. In `proxy-writes.js` the hits are comments plus one log tag (:746).

**The scan's definition is the real work.** The kind appears in shapes the allow-list (table keys + one rule for comments) doesn't cover:
- predicates (`recommendation-blind-read.js:44`, `pipeline-churn.js:233`, `run-view.js:470`, `run-closeout-state.js:260/266/317`)
- returned values (`recommendation-blind-read.js:69-70`)
- array members (`SPINE`, `run-view.js:37`, and `emits`)
- a call argument (`llm-jobs.js:46`)
- keys (`wall-clock-summary.js:57`, `prompt-formatters.js:651`, `stage-intent.js:40`, `completion-signals.js:253`, `run-view.js:80`)

I'd reuse the AST walk in `lin-4458-comment-kind-census.test.js` (acorn, `scannedFiles()`):
- Comments drop out by construction, which gives the one rule.
- `Property` keys are the allow-listed part.
- The kind matches exact `Literal` values only.
- The heading matches as a substring of `Literal` and `TemplateElement`.

`SPINE` should import the constant, not be allow-listed.

**Byte-identical has no baseline yet.** `completion-signals.js`'s three headings (:254, :259, :262) sit inside rendered prose. `prompt-size-budget.test.js` pins counts, not bytes. Before editing, capture `generatePrompt` for every `PROMPT_TEMPLATES` key, fresh and fix round, with real context, plus `JSON.stringify(COMPLETION_SIGNALS)`, then diff after. Interpolating `${BLIND_READ_HEADING}` is safe. Re-spelling "better, the same or worse" from `BLIND_READ_VERDICTS` isn't, because it doesn't match the array's join.

**The Waiting entry outruns this scope.** It also names the verdict words in `completion-signals.js` and the route module not importing `BLIND_READ_KIND` (now `code-routes.js`). Take those on, or rewrite the entry to say what stays and why.

**`VIRTUAL_PROMPTS.BLIND_READ`** has no reader at BASE, and `workflow-config.js` is Platform's. Delete it rather than import into it.

**Order:** placement ruling → render baseline → scan (red) → callers → Waiting entry.

## Survey global: LIN-4466 @ e666c4b60

**Where it lands.** The work lands in `lib/prompts/blind-read-words.js`, a clean leaf that imports nothing, and in the ring of per-kind tables around it. Seven modules already import from the leaf. The rest of the run code still types the kind bare. The trend is good: LIN-4458 (one classifier) and LIN-4465 (one route list) both gave scattered knowledge one home, and this task does the same.

**The site list has drifted since the breakdown.** Scanning at e666c4b60:
- **Missing from the list:** `lib/code-routes.js:52–56`. It landed in #2433 (this survey's base), after the breakdown's re-check at `5dcf5bcda`. It types `'blind-read'` three times: as the entry's `name`, in a comment, and in `emits`. The scan will go red there. Is the route's name the kind (import it) or a coincidence (allow-list it with a reason)?
- **Comment-only, so the comment rule covers them:** `run-ledger.js` (already imports the heading), `routes/proxy-writes.js`, `stage-intent.js:13`.
- **No hit at all:** `prompt-trace-store.js`. Drop it from the list rather than look for a fix.
- **Same string, different concept:** `run-closeout-state.js` uses `'blind-read'` as a `waitsOn` *state value* (lines 160, 166, 260, 266, 317), next to the separate reason `'blind-read-missing'`. If you import `BLIND_READ_KIND` there, the state becomes the kind by name. Defensible, but say so. LIN-4460 is editing this file too.
- **Elsewhere:** `lib/proxy-instructions.js:929` (a hard-coded kind list), `public/llms.txt` and `scripts/`. State the scan's scope, or the allow-list will grow one path at a time.

**Done the obvious way, it adds a second copy.** `tests/unit/stage-kind-tables.test.js` already lists every table keyed by kind (`STAGE_INTENT`, `STAGE_LABELS`, `BUCKET_OF_KIND`, `JOBS`, `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS`…), each with a reason. A new source-scan test with its own "table keys, each with a reason" allow-list would be a second inventory of those same tables. When someone adds a table, it would need adding to both, and nothing would notice if only one got it. Better: put the scan in `stage-kind-tables.test.js`, or give the two tests one shared table inventory.

The second constant has a clean fix: `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS.BLIND_READ: BLIND_READ_KIND`. Importing the leaf is cycle-safe because it imports nothing. Interpolating the heading into `completion-signals.js`'s three strings keeps the bytes identical. The render-equality witness covers them.

**What else has to learn about it.** The leaf's header claim ("none retypes them") becomes true. Its Waiting entry in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` (lines 143–149) also names the **verdict words** retyped in `completion-signals.js`, and this task doesn't touch them. Retire the entry only in part, and keep the verdict-words clause, or the doc will claim more than the code does.

**Better, at this task's cost:** add `code-routes.js` to the site list, fold the scan into the existing kind-table guard, and record a one-line decision on whether `waitsOn` and the route name *are* the kind.

**Better still, not this task's:** the deeper symptom is that a stage kind is a row in about nine parallel tables. `stage-kind-tables.test.js` guards that, but doesn't remove it. One kind-descriptor registry that the tables derive from would make the spelling question disappear. That's a ticket of its own.

## Summary: piece 2 done, PR open and CI green

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2441 (branch `feat/lin-4466-blind-read-one-home`, commit `9b3cf5322`). CI: all 8 checks pass (Unit tests, Unit tests proxy, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success).

- The blind read's kind, `## Blind read` heading and verdict words come only from `lib/prompts/blind-read-words.js`. Callers import them, and the completion signals keep their prose.
- New source-scan witness in `tests/unit/stage-kind-tables.test.js`. It was red at HEAD with 25 findings and is green now.
- Byte-identical renders for all 20 templates, fresh and fix round, plus `COMPLETION_SIGNALS`.
- Retires the blind-read Waiting entry in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md`.
- Placement: the leaf stays put, and four Runs/Platform imports of it are accepted. Recorded on LIN-4448.

### Leftovers
- The shipped-source scan scope was spelled twice, in LIN-4458's census and in the new blind-read scan. Tidied: both now import `tests/unit/helpers/shipped-sources.js`.
- The header of `tests/unit/stage-kind-tables.test.js` did not mention the scan it now holds. Tidied.
- The `lib/llm-jobs.js` header said it imports nothing, which my change made untrue. Tidied.
- The leaf's line in `docs/architecture/source-map.md` did not list the two prose forms. Tidied.
- Noted: a Lesson in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` for the next builder, on the blind read's words, their one owner and their scan.

Retires: `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md` "`lib/run-live-wait.js`: `docs/plans/survey.md` still names the live-stage wait's old file". Fixed: the survey plan now names `lib/run-live-wait.js`.

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2441, head `b7ca2b86dc5e1c1f4b7b4687d27d6cfc6e3da50a`. CI: all 8 checks pass.

## Review — LIN-4466

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2441 at head `b7ca2b86dc5e1c1f4b7b4687d27d6cfc6e3da50a` (two commits on `e666c4b60`, which is current `origin/main`; mergeable).

CI: green. All 8 checks pass at `b7ca2b86d`: Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success.

### What I checked myself
- **Renders are byte-identical.** I re-ran this myself instead of trusting the builder's run. I rendered `generatePrompt` for all 20 `PROMPT_TEMPLATES` keys, fresh and with a fix-round context, using the `prompt-size-budget` fixtures, at base `e666c4b60` and at the head. The same file also captured every template `description`, `COMPLETION_SIGNALS`, `JOBS`, `CODE_ROUTES` names and `emits`, `SPINE` and `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS`. `cmp` found the two outputs identical (267,738 bytes each).
- **The scan was red on base.** I ran the new scan against the base sources: 24 findings across code-routes, completion-signals, llm-jobs, pipeline-churn, prompt-template-defs, recommendation-blind-read, run-closeout-state, run-trail, run-view and workflow-config. That matches the sites the ask names, with the ground moved since (as the Surveys noted). It is green at the head: `stage-kind-tables` passes 39 of 39.
- **Mutation checks**, each reverted afterwards:
  - `SPINE` set back to the literal `'blind-read'`: red.
  - The completion signal's heading set back to the literal `## Blind read`: red.
  - `{ 'blind-read': 1 }` added in `run-trail.js`, which is not a table file: red.
  - The kind and the heading added in a comment: green, as the one comment rule intends.
  - The heading typed in the registry: red.
  - A predicate typing `'blind-read'` in `prompt-template-defs.js`: green. The ask exempts the registry, so this is correct.
  - **`{ 'blind-read': 1 }` in a non-table object inside `run-view.js`: green.** This is a gap; see the ledger.
- **Regression check:** `git log` on the changed files shows no revert and no earlier fix the change undoes. Every code change swaps a literal for the leaf's constant, with the same value.
- **Placement:** the accepted Runs/Platform → LLM edges are recorded on LIN-4448 (comment of 20:09Z) and in the PR body. The code-shape tests pass in CI.
- **Rulings:** none open for LIN-4466 (`/rulings?includeResolved=true` returns 0 rows). I raise no `DECISION:`.
- **Leftovers `Retires:`:** it names the `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md` entry about `docs/plans/survey.md` naming the live-stage wait's old file. The diff removes that entry and fixes the path. Confirmed.
- **Waiting entry:** the blind-read entry in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` is removed whole, and every clause of it is now true in code:
  - the bare kinds are imported;
  - `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS.BLIND_READ` is now `BLIND_READ_KIND`;
  - the heading and the verdict words in completion-signals are interpolated;
  - code-routes imports the kind;
  - the scan checks the literals.

  The new Lesson is accurate.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The class is a stage kind's spelling retyped outside its owner. For this kind, the scan now holds lib/, routes/, server.js and the stability script.

One sibling is left: `lib/proxy-instructions.js:929` types `blind-read` inside the verb-override prose list. That is a prompt-text list of kinds, not a predicate, so it is **outside** this ticket's class ("in a predicate"). The existing Waiting entry in `docs/areas/agent-api.md` already covers it ("the verb-override lists … fall short, and no test keeps either in step"), so it needs no new entry.

The wider symptom is a kind spread across about 9 parallel tables, which a descriptor registry would remove (global Survey). That is **outside**, and LIN-4467 (piece 3, "one record per stage kind") is already its home.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (the witness the ask specifies: "table keys, each with a short reason"). The scan's key allowance works per file, not per table. `blindReadFindings` lets any non-computed `'blind-read'` key through in any file that hosts a `TABLES` entry. So a new non-table object keyed by the kind in, say, `lib/run-view.js` passes, and I confirmed this by mutation. **Settle before merge.** In `tests/unit/stage-kind-tables.test.js`, switch to `walk.fullAncestor` and allow a key only when its enclosing `VariableDeclarator`'s name and file match a `TABLES` entry name of the form `NAME (file)`. In `lib/prompt-template-defs.js`, allow it under `PROMPT_TEMPLATES` or `STAGE_LEADS`. Then add a shape witness asserting that `blindReadFindings('lib/run-view.js', "export const ZZ = { 'blind-read': 1 };")` is non-empty. I checked that all 7 real key hits are direct rows of a named table: `COMPLETION_SIGNALS`, `GROUNDING_BY_KIND`, `STAGE_LEADS`, `PROMPT_TEMPLATES`, `STAGE_INTENT`, `STAGE_LABELS` and `BUCKET_OF_KIND`. The stricter rule therefore stays green at the head. **How to tell right from wrong:** that mutation goes red, and the unmutated head stays 39 of 39 green.
- **Inside**, discharged: renders byte-identical before and after. CI pins byte counts, not bytes, so I re-ran the comparison myself (above).

### Fix for close-out (not a ledger item)
- The PR #2441 body shows every backtick escaped as `` \` ``, so the code spans render literally. Rewrite the body with plain backticks (`gh pr edit 2441 --body-file …`).

### How the work meets what was asked
- *One home: `lib/prompts/blind-read-words.js`.* Met. The leaf now also builds the two verdict prose forms from the words.
- *Outside the leaf and the registry, nothing types the kind in a predicate or the heading; callers import the constants.* Met. The scan is green, and the grep left only comments, table keys and the registry.
- *The sites the plan names*, `recommendation-blind-read`, `pipeline-churn`, `run-view`, `run-closeout-state`, `workflow-config` (`VIRTUAL_PROMPTS.BLIND_READ`) and the three headings in `completion-signals`: all met.
- *The sites the review adds:* met as they stand at base.
  - `stage-intent`, `prompt-formatters` and `wall-clock-summary` hold table keys only, and they are allowed as table rows.
  - `llm-jobs` is converted.
  - `run-ledger` already imported the leaf.
  - `proxy-writes` has comments only.
  - `prompt-trace-store` has no occurrence.
  - `code-routes`, which landed after the list was written, is converted.
- *Leave `COMPLETED` alone.* Met: it is untouched.
- *Renders byte-identical, the sentence not re-worded.* Met, re-verified above.
- *A source scan fails on any occurrence outside the leaf and the registry, and fails today.* Met. It was red on base and is green at the head.
- *Allow-list: table keys, each with a reason, plus one general rule for comments.* Met in part. The AST walk gives the comment rule by construction, and it shares the `TABLES` inventory as the surveys advised. But the key allowance is coarser than "table keys": it covers whole files. That is the inside ledger item.
- *Collisions.* Moot: LIN-4460, #2427 and piece 1 had all merged before this PR's base.
- *Retires: the header claim, the second constant, the Waiting entry.* Met.
- *Every PR names what it retires, edits the Waiting entries, leaves `docs/reviews/` unchanged.* Met; no `docs/reviews/` file was touched.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

## Blind read
Verdict: better. The blind read's kind, heading and verdict prose now come from one leaf (`lib/prompts/blind-read-words.js`), held by an AST scan in `tests/unit/stage-kind-tables.test.js`, and the scan scope the two source censuses shared is now one helper (`tests/unit/helpers/shipped-sources.js`) instead of a copy in `tests/unit/lin-4458-comment-kind-census.test.js`. On the other side, `lib/workflow-config.js` imported nothing before and now depends on `lib/prompts/`, and the stage-kind lists now mix one constant with literals (`lib/run-view.js` SPINE).

Read: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2441 at `b7ca2b86d` against `e666c4b60`.

### Inside the area, fix-sized
- `lib/run-closeout-state.js` (runs-and-dispatch): the new `// LIN-4466` line comment sits between `closeOutWaitsOn`'s JSDoc block and the function, so the doc no longer directly precedes what it documents, and the JSDoc still spells the return as `'blind-read'`. Fix: move the sentence into the JSDoc block.
- `tests/unit/stage-kind-tables.test.js` (llm-and-prompts): the header says the kind may be a literal "only as a row key of a table listed in TABLES", but the scan exempts by file, not by table. `TABLE_FILES` is pulled by regex out of the TABLES labels, so any object keyed `'blind-read'` anywhere in those files passes, and in `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` every literal passes, including call arguments such as `goal('blind-read')` and `COMPLETION_SIGNALS['blind-read']`. Fix: make the header and the block comment above `WORDS_LEAF` say the exemption is per file.

### Inside the area, larger
- `lib/workflow-config.js` (platform-and-plumbing): a label-config file that imported nothing now imports from `lib/prompts/`. That adds a plumbing → llm-and-prompts edge, and `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS.BLIND_READ` and `BLIND_READ_KIND` are now two exported names for one value, while the other 15 `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS` entries stay literals. This is larger than a fix: putting the literal back would trip the new scan, which exempts only keys and not values, so it needs a decision about where the kind constants live and what the scan allows.
- `lib/run-view.js` (runs-and-dispatch): `SPINE = ['plan', 'implementation', 'review', BLIND_READ_KIND, 'close-out']`. The same goes for the `COMMENT_KINDS` rows in `lib/run-trail.js` and for `lib/code-routes.js`. One stage kind now has a constant and a guard, and every other kind in the same lists is still typed as a literal, so the next stage added has two conventions to choose from. This is larger than a fix because it needs a decision: constants for every kind, or only for this one.

### Outside the area
None.

## Close-out — LIN-4466

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2441, squash commit `dc12ca51b`, pinned to head `991ba3580` (`--match-head-commit`). Base was current `main` (`e666c4b60`); no conflict.

**What it does and how it meets the ask:** the blind read's kind, `## Blind read` heading and verdict words come only from `lib/prompts/blind-read-words.js`; callers import them; an AST scan in `tests/unit/stage-kind-tables.test.js` holds it; renders are byte-identical (review re-ran the comparison, 267,738 bytes each at base and head). The review's account of each ask line stands; I did not re-litigate it.

### Changes I made after the approval (commit `991ba3580`, nobody reviews these further)
- **Review ledger item (inside), the scan's key allowance was per file, not per table.** `blindReadFindings` now uses `walk.fullAncestor`: a `'blind-read'` key passes only as a direct row of `const NAME = { ... }` where `file#NAME` matches a `NAME (file)` label already in `TABLES` (or `PROMPT_TEMPLATES` in the registry). No second table inventory. Witnesses added: `export const ZZ = { 'blind-read': 1 };` in `lib/run-view.js` is rejected (the review's mutation), plus a nested key, a wrapped table (`f({...})`) and a table name in another table's file; the registry's `PROMPT_TEMPLATES` row and a real `STAGE_LABELS` row still pass. The existing registry fixture was renamed to `PROMPT_TEMPLATES` to match. The header comment now states the per-table rule, which is true.
- **Review's fix-sized find:** the `closeOutWaitsOn` sentence moved from between the JSDoc and the declaration into the JSDoc (`lib/run-closeout-state.js`).
- **PR body:** escaped backticks rewritten as plain ones; a close-out section appended.
- **Blind read, larger finds → Waiting entries** (not fix-sized; no new design made here): the mixed constant/literal kind convention (`docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md`, LIN-4467 as its home) and the `workflow-config.js` plumbing → prompts edge (`docs/areas/platform-and-plumbing.md`; the edge itself was already accepted on LIN-4448). Both are inside this change's class, so they are Waiting entries, not tickets.

### Ledger
- **Inside, key allowance per file:** fixed as above. Distinguishing precondition: the mutation `{ 'blind-read': 1 }` in a non-table object inside `lib/run-view.js` now fails (witness in the suite), and the unmutated head stays green (`stage-kind-tables` 39/39; full `npm run test:unit` 25,797 pass, 0 fail, run locally).
- **Inside, byte-identical renders:** discharged by review's own re-run; the post-approval change touches only a test and a comment, no render path.
- **Outside:** `lib/proxy-instructions.js:929` verb-override list is already in `docs/areas/agent-api.md` Waiting; the nine-parallel-tables symptom is LIN-4467. No new ticket, no monitor or rollback was named by review, so none is claimed.
- **Blind-read open question** (mixed conventions, Platform edge): no action needed here; recorded as the Waiting entries above.

### CI
All 8 checks green on `991ba3580` before the merge: Unit tests, Unit tests (proxy, clock +400d), E2E 1–4, Secret scan, CI success.

### After the merge
The repo has no deploy workflow and the ledger names no post-deploy step. The change alters no render. Nothing to run live.

### Related tickets / follow-ups
No ticket filed (no outside find passed the consequence test). LIN-4467 stays Todo and is unblocked by this piece. No existing related tickets to close.

description:
## As asked

Piece 2 of LIN-4448's plan (behaviour **B**). The blind read's kind and heading get one home: `lib/prompts/blind-read-words.js`.

**Approach**

* Outside that leaf and the template registry, nothing types the kind `'blind-read'` in a predicate, or the heading `## Blind read`. Callers import `BLIND_READ_KIND` and the heading constant from the leaf.
* Sites the plan names: `lib/recommendation-blind-read.js`, `lib/pipeline-churn.js`, `lib/run-view.js`, `lib/run-closeout-state.js`, `lib/workflow-config.js` (`VIRTUAL_PROMPTS.BLIND_READ`), and `lib/completion-signals.js`, which types the heading three times.
* Sites the review adds, where the scan will also hit: `lib/prompts/stage-intent.js`, `prompt-formatters.js`, `lib/wall-clock-summary.js`, `lib/llm-jobs.js`, `lib/run-ledger.js`, `routes/proxy-writes.js` and `prompt-trace-store.js`.
* Leave `COMPLETED` in `recommendation-blind-read.js` alone. It retires with LIN-4447's move 3 (LIN-4460).
* Rendered prompts stay **byte-identical**. The blind read's sentence is piloted, so don't re-word it.

**Testing (witnesses)**

* A source-scan test fails on any occurrence of the kind or heading outside the leaf and the registry. It fails today at the sites above.
* Its allow-list has two parts: table keys, each with a short reason, and **one general rule for comments**, not one entry per comment.
* Renders are byte-identical before and after.

**Collisions:** LIN-4460 edits `lib/run-closeout-state.js`. Open PR #2427 (LIN-4455) edits `lib/run-view.js` and `lib/wall-clock-summary.js`. Piece 1 edits `lib/recommendation-blind-read.js`. `completion-signals.js`, `run-closeout-state.js`, `pipeline-churn.js` and `run-view.js` are Runs-registered files, and the seam correction on LIN-4447 lists them.

**Retires:** the leaf's untrue header claim (it becomes true), the second constant, and the Waiting entry on the blind read's words.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4448 (LLM & prompts, left simpler). The full approved plan is the parent's description, section `## Implementation Plan`, and its amendments are in the parent's comment `### Plan Review Verdict` (72406236-9316-4004-98ee-70d8fba0cb09). The parent's `## As asked` block sets the scope.

Session fit: fits one session

Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4448's approving plan-review (comment 72406236-9316-4004-98ee-70d8fba0cb09, rev 1)

**Grounding commits:** the plan was written at `JKershaw/LinearViewer` main `2bf788b6d` (surveys at `4b5001ddf`) and reviewed at `c205190fd`. The breakdown re-checked at `5dcf5bcda`. The only change since is LIN-4457 (#2424), and the one plan file it touches is the cost-read entry in `docs/architecture/source-map.md`.

**Starting point:** the parent's approved plan. Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course, and say so in a comment on LIN-4448.

**Every PR names what it retires** (the LIN-4414 rule). It edits the Waiting entries in `docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md` that it settles. It respects that note's Lessons and leaves `docs/reviews/` reports unchanged.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Size of the move

**Size:** a small tidy
**Why:** Gives the blind read's kind and heading one home as asked, and first brings its verdict words into that home too, so the Waiting entry on those words can retire whole rather than in part.
**Cuts:** none
**Decided by:** the standing policy

## Implemented

Implemented in [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2441](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2441>) (squash commit `dc12ca51b`). The parent's approved plan (LIN-4448) was implemented as approved, with these deviations: the scope also covers the verdict prose and `lib/code-routes.js` (landed after the plan), `VIRTUAL_PROMPTS.BLIND_READ` imports the leaf, and the scan lives in `tests/unit/stage-kind-tables.test.js` on its shared `TABLES` inventory (key allowance per table). The full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.
